clue.text: People in a mess might well call for his services ().

definitions.text: People in a mess might well call for his services

parts.words: People in a mess might well call for his services
parts.note: a mess is where officers or a ship's crew eat, so those in it would summon the attendant who serves food there, not someone to tidy a muddle

explanation.surface: Anyone in a muddle may want a helper to sort things out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mess' wants to mean a muddle; it is the dining room of officers or sailors, where meals are served by an attendant.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the attendant on a ship or in a club or mess who serves meals and drinks.

clue.text: It's left in mug for nursing mother

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for left inside the word for mug

parts.note: a mug is a dupe, a sucker

explanation.surface: A drink left in a cup for a new mum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mug' suggests a cup; it is a gullible person.
explanation.definitionFit: A suckler is an animal, especially a cow, that suckles its young.

clue.text: Leaving out the objection

explanation.surface: Someone omits the protest.
explanation.definitionFit: An exception is something excluded, and to take exception is to raise an objection.

clue.text: A capital perfume!

parts.note: Roma is the Italian name of Rome, a capital city

explanation.surface: An excellent scent!
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' reads as 'excellent'; it is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasant smell, a scent or fragrance.

clue.text: Dread injury to unlucky stuntman

indicators.note: injury suggests damage, so the letters of dread are knocked into a new order

parts.note: evil can mean ill-omened, unlucky

explanation.surface: A stuntman fears injury on an ill-fated day.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless person who performs dangerous feats.

clue.text: Woman is out of bed getting some cheese

indicators.note: the woman's name is outside the bed, wrapped round it, so these words signal a container

parts.note: Rita is a woman's name
a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A woman gets up and has some cheese for breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is out of bed' reads as a woman getting up; 'is out of' is the container signal, the woman's name sitting outside the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ricotta is a soft white Italian whey cheese, one kind among many.

clue.text: He produces cordage with some special properties

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words is taken, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A craftsman makes rope with unusual qualities.
explanation.definitionFit: One who makes ropes, a rope-maker.

clue.text: Caught over brochures, gets less

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
on can mean over, as in a lid on a jar
tracts are pamphlets or brochures

explanation.surface: Someone caught out over leaflets ends up with less.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that shrinks or narrows becomes smaller.

clue.text: Aim to take public transport

explanation.surface: Someone aims to catch a bus or tube.
explanation.definitionFit: To train a gun is to point it; a railway train carries the public.

clue.text: Readiness of a head to retain physical training

indicators.note: retain means keep inside, so the training abbreviation is held within

parts.note: a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: A headteacher keeps up gym lessons and stays ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' suggests a headteacher; it is a headland, NESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Being quick to learn or suitable shows aptitude, a readiness.

clue.text: Firm receiving bill with a raw material for making chocolate

indicators.note: the firm takes in the other pieces, so receiving signals that they go inside it

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
AC, short for account, is a bill

explanation.surface: A company takes delivery of an invoice along with its chocolate ingredient.
explanation.definitionFit: Cacao seeds are the beans from which cocoa and chocolate are made.

clue.text: Divided about cribbed article, and apologetic

indicators.note: the word for divided goes around the other pieces, so about here means surrounding

parts.note: rent means torn apart, divided
pent means confined, as in a crib
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone split over a plagiarised piece and is sorry about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cribbed' suggests copied work; here it means shut in, PENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sorry for a wrong is penitent, regretful.

clue.text: European project accepted by youth with little hesitation

indicators.note: the youth takes in the project, so accepted by puts the plan inside the boy

parts.note: a lad is a youth
a plan is a project
er is the short sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A young person takes on a European scheme after a brief pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from the far north of Scandinavia, in Europe, inhabited by the Sami.

clue.text: Put in order for a large stove

explanation.surface: Someone arranges for a big cooker to be installed.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange things in rows is to array them; a kitchen range is a large cooking stove with ovens.

clue.text: Original in her flower-arranging

indicators.note: arranging means the letters of these words are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone shows originality in arranging flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' reads as a bloom; it is something that flows, a river. 'Original' is surface dressing, describing the arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Crosswords use 'flower' for a river, a thing that flows; this is the great river of Germany.

clue.text: In Parisian trip, there should be time for 7

parts.note: en is French for in
a tour is a trip
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A trip to Paris must allow time to catch a train.
explanation.walkthrough: '7' points to the answer to 7 down, read here as a retinue.
explanation.definitionFit: A train in the sense of retinue is the group of attendants following someone important.

clue.text: Few are reflective about financial liabilities, though honest

parts.note: standing in for five, V in Roman numerals

indicators.note: a reflection shows a thing back to front, so the word are is read backwards

parts.note: c, for circa, means about
IOUs are written promises of debts owed

explanation.surface: A few people look back on debts yet remain upright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflective' turns ARE into ERA. 'Few' must be a slip for 'Five', V.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone truthful always tells it straight.

clue.text: Set up diverting warning for drivers

parts.note: to rear is to raise or set up
light entertainment is diverting

explanation.surface: A diversion is set up with a sign warning motorists.
explanation.definitionFit: The red lamp on the back of a vehicle warns drivers behind.

clue.text: Classified as awfully grandiose!

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters of grandiose are badly jumbled into another order

explanation.surface: Something filed away seems terribly pompous!
explanation.definitionFit: Things classified are arranged and sorted.

clue.text: The Spanish dish is about to turn brown — have a cigar

indicators.note: the Spanish dish goes round the other piece, so is about signals a container

parts.note: paella is the famous rice dish of Spain

indicators.note: turn means the word for brown is read backwards

parts.note: tan is a brown colour

explanation.surface: A diner about to brown the paella lights up a cigar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is about to turn brown' reads as cooking; split it as 'is about' (container) and 'to turn' (reversal, making NAT).
explanation.definitionFit: A panatella is a long thin cigar.

clue.text: Put a hundred in the salver to be conciliatory

indicators.note: in puts the other pieces inside the word for a salver

parts.note: a salver is a tray or plate
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Drop a hundred onto the collection plate to make amends.
explanation.definitionFit: To pacify someone is a conciliatory act.

clue.text: Sense this could be a good deal

explanation.surface: Someone senses this may be a bargain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a good deal' sounds like a bargain; it is the sense in 'a sight better', meaning a lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Vision is one of the five senses; informally 'a sight more' means a great deal more.

clue.text: A hold -up for the board

parts.note: not a delay for directors but a support that holds up a tabletop plank

explanation.surface: A delay faced by company directors.
explanation.definitionFit: A trestle is a frame supporting a table top or plank.

clue.text: Mademoiselle's send-off

parts.note: the farewell a French young lady would say, a goodbye in her own language

explanation.surface: A French young woman says goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: This French farewell means goodbye, literally commending you to God.

clue.text: They're thought to turn aside

indicators.note: turn signals the letters of aside being turned round into a new order

explanation.surface: People supposed to step aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thought' looks like a verb; it is the noun plural, things thought.
explanation.definitionFit: Notions are products of thinking.

clue.text: Acknowledgment of concession

explanation.surface: A note of thanks given in return for a concession.
explanation.definitionFit: Making allowance for something acknowledges it; an allowance is also a sum or right conceded to someone.

clue.text: Make a row

parts.note: not to cause a noisy quarrel but to set things in a straight line

explanation.surface: Kick up a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting things in a straight line arranges them in a row.

clue.text: Spring up to the end of June in general?

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to flow is to spring forth, like a fountain

indicators.note: this word picks out the closing letter, or closing letters, of the words it governs

explanation.surface: Is spring up until late June, generally?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spring' looks like the season; it is a verb, FLOW, turned to WOLF.
explanation.definitionFit: James Wolfe was the British general who took Quebec in 1759.

clue.text: Reaching the mean state — getting on in years

parts.note: to aver is to state firmly
growing older is aging

explanation.surface: Someone reaches a middling condition while growing old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a noun after 'mean'; it is the verb, AVER.
explanation.definitionFit: Working out an arithmetic mean of figures is finding their average.

clue.text: Sound record made by famous pianist

indicators.note: sound signals that the word for record is said out loud

parts.note: a list is a written record

explanation.surface: A recording made by a celebrated pianist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound record' suggests an audio recording; 'Sound' is the homophone signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Liszt was the celebrated Hungarian virtuoso pianist and composer.

clue.text: Egghead back from the Orient

parts.note: the head of the word egg, its first letter E
astern means at the back of a ship

explanation.surface: An intellectual returns from the Far East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' wants to be an intellectual; split it as egg's head, its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The Orient is the East, so something from there is of the East.

clue.text: A lever's setting altered as required

indicators.note: setting means the letters of the word altered are placed in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A lever's position has been adjusted as needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as required' rounds off the surface; the anagram is of ALTERED.
explanation.definitionFit: A treadle is a foot-operated lever driving a machine such as a sewing machine.
